Honest thoughts? The more I look at it the worse it gets. 


I don't think this tool or approach will go far, this is a mess of mismatched assets. A world model like genie 3 already produces better results.

comments.author: ShivEater
comments.body:
I think AI tools are great.  I think that right now they are worse than they will ever be in the future. 

But come on: this is bad!  Even if you think we're at the "Will Smith eating spaghetti" stage, you don't need to pretend that's a good thing.  It doesn't matter how long the processing takes.  It matters if the result is good.  This is bad.
